Data & methodology

Jogo Bonito is a working replay prototype. These fictional fixtures use deterministic synthetic events, not a live sports feed or licensed match record.

What the numbers mean

Shot xG is an illustrative distance-and-angle logistic formula. Outcome estimates use independent Poisson remaining-goal distributions with neutral pre-match rates, adjusted by the replay's xG. Neither model is trained or calibrated. Possession approximates completed-pass share; momentum sums recent attacking events.

Explore the architecture

The optional Python API persists normalized events in SQLite, rejects conflicting duplicate IDs, and exposes deterministic replay snapshots. Redis Streams, PostgreSQL, trained ML, WebSockets, and production monitoring remain planned. The hosted demo runs entirely in your browser.
